questions.question: What must a packed causal mask enforce?
options: Same segment and permitted causal keys, plus explicit padding behavior
questions.explanation: Packing combines positions in storage, not their semantic context. Segment and validity constraints retain example boundaries.
optionFeedback: A causal mask still allows earlier tokens from another packed example. Require the same segment as well as a valid causal position.
Packing combines positions in storage, not their semantic context. Segment and validity constraints retain example boundaries.
Equal token IDs do not imply the same example or a valid attention edge. Use segment IDs, positions and padding validity.
